traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria in docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md are fully implemented.
The project provides a complete maintenance toolkit: - Programmatic API (detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport) exported via src/maintenance and wired through the main plugin export. - A dedicated CLI, traceability-maint, with subcommands detect/verify/report/update, argument parsing, JSON/text output modes, exit codes, dry-run support, and robust error handling. - Extensive unit, integration, and performance tests explicitly tied to this story and its REQ-MAINT-* requirements, all passing in the latest Jest run. - User-facing documentation in README.md and user-docs/api-reference.md describing both the APIs and CLI with concrete examples and clearly stated safety guarantees.
Optional implementation notes in the story (e.g., filesystem watching, Git hook integration, AST-based updates) are guidance rather than hard requirements and are not necessary for meeting the specified acceptance criteria. Based on the concrete code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully satisfied.
